U.note: Polished ring dial with clear phase and state, solid timestamp-based timing, live-region announcements and keyboard shortcuts, slightly padded by undo-reset and skip.

V.note: Handsome compact card with working timer and auto-advance, but no aria state, no timer role, no live announcements and the finish silently jumps phase.

W.note: Big clear clock and thoughtful status text with confirm-reset and auto-start options, but overbuilt with a reset-whole-cycle flow, notifications and a plain, cramped phone layout.

X.note: Lean and correct, but the ring is a thin line, nothing is announced to screen readers and the finish switches phase with only a beep.

Y.note: Genuinely simple and complete: huge clock, progress bar, mode tabs, a finished hold state with Start next button, live announcements, and a clean phone layout.

Z.note: Bold full-colour phases with a giant clock and good phone layout, but padded with presets, persistence, auto-start and clear-count undo, and skip from focus always goes to a short break.
